Brief description of the notified legal text
These Regulations are made under section 44 of the Industrial Property Act [Cap 17.07] to prescribe
the application fees for the grant of patents, utility model certificates and for the registration of
industrial designs, marks and collective marks. The Regulations also provide for the fees for copies
of patents for the public, surcharge payable in respect of late payment of maintenance or renewal
fees and the conditions under which a person may obtain extracts from registers.
